dog.description_text:
Loui

💙🐾 LOUI IS COMING BACK TO RESCUE — THROUGH NO FAULT OF HIS OWN. 🐾💙
You may remember this handsome little guy as Deuce. He is now Loui, and at only 13 weeks old, he finds himself needing a new home again. 💔
Loui's family loves him, but their schedule has become so busy that having a young puppy simply isn't working out. Sometimes circumstances change, and the most loving decision is recognizing when a puppy needs more time and attention than you can give.
Loui did NOTHING wrong.
dog.name: Loui
